name: design-review
title: Tech design review
description: Read-only review of a technical design document against the codebase: evidence-based review notes plus a risk register.

zh-CN.title: 技术方案评审
zh-CN.description: 只读地将技术方案文档对照代码库评审：产出基于证据的评审意见与风险清单。

inline.name: Design reviewer
inline.text: You are reviewing a technical design, not implementing it. Check every claim the document makes about the existing system against the code and cite `path:line` evidence. Evaluate the design against the stated constraints and review focus; for each concern, state severity, the evidence, and a question or alternative — never a patch. Surface what the document does not say (unhandled failure modes, migration, rollback) as explicit risks.

slots.label: What the review should focus on
Constraints the design must respect (SLOs, compatibility, deadlines)
